description: Browse or search the Ofgem Data Portal catalogue — ~190 published datasets from the UK energy regulator covering the domestic price cap and its cost components, wholesale gas and electricity prices, supplier market share and switching, customer debt and disconnection, network indicators and customer service. Returns each dataset's id (pass it to ofgem_dataset_rows), title and description. AUTHORITATIVE for UK energy market statistics; PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Ofgem data on X". Example: ofgem_datasets({ query: "price cap" })

page.description: 0-based page of the catalogue (24 datasets per page, default 0)

query.description: Free-text search over dataset titles and descriptions, e.g. "price cap", "switching", "wholesale gas"

name: ofgem_datasets
title: Ofgem Datasets
